title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يترأس اجتماع مجلس إدارة مركز تكوين العلماء.
title_en: The Sheikh Chairs the Meeting of the Board of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars
body_ar: ترأس فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو اليوم لأربعاء 22 ذي القعدة 1435هـ الموافق 17 سبتمبر 2014م بمباني مركز تكوين العلماء اجتماع مجلس إدارة المركز في دورته العادية، وبحضور كل من الدكتور محمد المختار ولد محمد المامي المدير العام للمركز وباقي أعضاء المجلس الموقر. وقد ناقش المجلس أبرز بنود الخطة التسييرية للمركز في الفترة الماضية و ومن المقرر أن يتخذ المجلس القرارات اللآزمة بشأن مختلف النقاط التي شملها جدول أعماله، واعتماد الترتيبات التي من شأنها أن تسهل انسيابية العملية الإدارية والتنفيذية، وتحسين الأداء في مختلف المجالات التي تطالها اهتمامات المركز . و نشير إلى أن المجلس الإداري يتكون من (13) عضوا، بمن فيهم المدير العام ونائبه، ويتولى المصادقة على الخطط والميزانيات، ورقابة عمل المركز، وتعيين المجلس التربوي والعلمي، وتعيين الإدارة التنفيذية.. ويجتمع في دورة عادية كل (4) أشهر، ويعقد جلسات طارئة كلما دعاه الرئيس، أو نائبه، أو الإدارة التنفيذية، أو ثلثا أعضائه.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew chaired today, Wednesday 22 Dhu al-Qa'dah 1435 AH, corresponding to 17 September 2014, at the premises of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, the meeting of the Centre's board of directors in its ordinary session, attended by Dr Muhammad al-Mukhtar Ould Muhammad al-Mami, the Centre's director general, and the remaining members of the esteemed board.

The board discussed the principal items of the Centre's management plan for the past period, and it is expected that the board will take the necessary decisions on the various points covered by its agenda, and will adopt the arrangements apt to ease the flow of the administrative and executive process and to improve performance in the various fields the Centre's concerns reach into.

We note that the administrative board consists of thirteen members, including the director general and his deputy. It is responsible for approving plans and budgets, for oversight of the Centre's work, for appointing the educational and academic council, and for appointing the executive administration. It meets in ordinary session every four months, and holds emergency sessions whenever called by the chairman, by his deputy, by the executive administration, or by two thirds of its members.

flags.context: the date in the first sentence, against the CMS stamp of Thursday 18 September 2014
options: the record was written on Wednesday 17 September and uploaded the following day
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11) and a dating point. لأربعاء is a dropped alif for الأربعاء. More usefully: 17 September 2014 was indeed a Wednesday, and the record says 'today', while the CMS stamps it Thursday 18 September. This is direct evidence within the slice that the CMS timestamps are upload dates rather than composition dates, which is why date_is_cms_upload is set throughout.

translator_notes: An institutional notice. It contains nothing by the Sheikh and no religious content; he appears only as chairman.
The record also carries a doubled و in و ومن المقرر and اللآزمة for اللازمة; these are preserved in body_ar and not separately flagged.
مركز تكوين العلماء is rendered 'the Centre for the Formation of Scholars', the institution's usual English name. تكوين is formation in the sense of training, not creation.
